mapper.sql:
INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderPay OPay ON OPay.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OPay.PayNo = 1 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cPayType') CV ON OPay.PayType = CV.ConstrVal
INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON O.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON O.CustId = CI.CustId

where.if: AND (O.OrderPhoneNo LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pOrderPhoneNo},'%') OR O.OrderMobileNo LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pOrderPhoneNo},'%'))

if.test: pStartDate != null and pStartDate != '' and pEndDate != null and pEndDate != ''

where.if:
AND
(O.PayCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND O.PayCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
(O.ShipCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND O.ShipCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
(O.RefundCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND O.RefundCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
(O.OrderReciptDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND O.OrderReciptDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
AND (O.ShipCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pCompareDate}, '%Y%m%d') OR O.ShipCmpletDate IS NULL)

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(OP.SalePrice) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo) AS orderAmt, (SELECT MIN(ProdName) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo) AS prodName, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo) AS prodCount, (SELECT SUM(ProdQty) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo) AS prodQty, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OP.OrderState = '주문접수') AS readyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProdApprovLine OAL WHERE OAL.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OAL.ApprovResult = 'R') AS rejectCount, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OP.OrderState = '지불완료') AS approvCount, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OP.OrderState = '발주시작') AS deliCount, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OP.OrderState = '배송완료') AS completeCount, (SELECT COUNT(OP.OrderProdNo) FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP WHERE OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo AND OP.OrderState IN ('주문취소','환불완료')) AS cancelCount,
'' AS payType, '' AS payTypeName, '' AS cardComp, '' AS reciptBank, '' AS approvNo, '' AS reciptName, 0 AS payFee, IFNULL(O.PayCmpletDate,'') AS payCmpletDate,
OPay.PayType AS payType, CV.ConstrValDesc AS payTypeName, OPay.CardComp AS cardComp, OPay.ReciptBank AS reciptBank, OPay.ApprovNo AS approvNo, OPay.ReciptName AS reciptName, OPay.PayFee AS payFee, IFNULL(O.PayCmpletDate,OPay.PayDate) AS payCmpletDate,
O.OrderNo, O.CustId, O.LoginId, O.RecomId, O.OrderName, O.OrderCode, O.OrderEmail, O.OrderPhoneNo, O.OrderMobileNo, O.OrderZipcode, O.OrderAddr1, O.OrderAddr2, O.RecverName, O.RecverPhoneNo, O.RecverMobileNo, O.RecverZipcode, O.RecverAddr1, O.RecverAddr2, O.MoneyUnit, O.DeliMemo, O.OrderMemo, O.DeliHopeDate, O.OrderReciptDate, O.OrderCancelDate, O.ShipDirectDate, O.ShipCheckDate, O.ShipCmpletDate, O.DeliCmpletDate, O.RefundReciptDate, O.RefundRqstDate, O.RefundCmpletDate, O.AreaCode, O.OrderState, Ch.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, Ch.ChnlUrl, Ch.MngrMd AS chnlChrgName, O.Remark, O.State, O.ChangeDate, O.ChangeId, O.ChangeName, O.RegistDate, O.RegistId, O.RegistName FROM shopion.tOrdOrder O
) tab1
ORDER BY ${sidx} ${sord} ORDER BY orderNo DESC
LIMIT ${topCnt}, ${countPerPage}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdOrder ( OrderNo, CustId, LoginId, RecomId, OrderName, OrderCode, OrderEmail, OrderPhoneNo, OrderMobileNo, OrderZipcode, OrderAddr1, OrderAddr2, RecverName, RecverPhoneNo, RecverMobileNo, RecverZipcode, RecverAddr1, RecverAddr2, MoneyUnit, DeliMemo, OrderMemo, DeliHopeDate, OrderState, OrderReciptDate, AreaCode, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate , PayCmpletDate ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{custId}, #{loginId}, #{recomId}, #{orderName}, (SELECT CustCode FROM shopion.tPrfCust WHERE CustId = #{custId}), #{orderEmail}, #{orderPhoneNo}, #{orderMobileNo}, #{orderZipcode}, #{orderAddr1}, #{orderAddr2}, #{recverName}, #{recverPhoneNo}, #{recverMobileNo}, #{recverZipcode}, #{recverAddr1}, #{recverAddr2}, #{moneyUnit}, #{deliMemo}, #{orderMemo}, #{deliHopeDate}, #{orderState}, #{orderReciptDate}, #{areaCode}, #{chnlCode}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() , #{payCmpletDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOrdOrder SET OrderState = #{orderState}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() , PayCmpletDate = NOW() , ShipDirectDate = NOW() , ShipCheckDate = NOW() , ShipCmpletDate = NOW() , DeliCmpletDate = NOW() , RefundCmpletDate = NOW() , OrderCancelDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderState != '결제오류'

UPDATE shopion.tOrdOrder SET OrderState = #{orderState}, RefundCmpletDate = NULL, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderState != '결제오류'
